recipe.visualDefinition: A high-contrast 1960s psychedelic composition featuring a central photographic vignette framed by fluid, organic, Art Nouveau-inspired shapes and hand-drawn 'liquid' typography.
coreVisualRelationships: Interlocking organic shapes framing a central circular photograph
Typography integrated into the upper fluid border
High-saturation flat color fields contrasting with a naturalistic photo
Curvilinear paths guiding the eye around the central subject

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: A group photograph occupies the lower two-thirds of the frame, contained within a large circular cutout.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The large, warped title text in the upper third acts as the primary graphic anchor.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye follows the outer orange border inward through the swirling green and purple shapes to the central photo, then up to the title.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Minimal; the frame is densely packed with interlocking color fields and text.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Vibrant orange-red serves as the primary frame and background structure.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Lime green and sky blue provide high-contrast fills for the organic shapes.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Lavender and yellow act as secondary accents within the fluid pattern.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation across all graphic elements with flat, unshaded values.
paletteRestrictions: Avoid muted earth tones in the graphic frame

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Heavy, rounded sans-serif with extreme warping
letterConstructionRules: Letters must follow the curvature of the containing organic shape
Variable stroke widths that expand and contract like liquid
Tight, interlocking kerning with no straight baselines
characterSpecificRedesigns: Descenders and ascenders elongated to fill negative space
Counters are minimized or distorted into teardrop shapes
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Extreme contrast between fluid, illustrative display type and functional, rigid metadata type.

preserve: The liquid warping of the main title
avoid: Standard straight-line fonts for the title

candidateDirections.reason: Captures the flared, psychedelic weight of the era.
Provides the necessary organic, rounded terminals.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a vibrant 1960s psychedelic frame using interlocking organic shapes in orange, lime green, and lavender. Leave a large circular void in the center containing a naturalistic photograph of a group of people in a park setting.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Apply custom liquid-style lettering to the upper green shape, following its curved contours. Add small, clean sans-serif metadata in the top corners in black.

verificationChecks: Does the title text follow the curve of the graphic shapes?
Is the color palette limited to high-saturation flat fills?
Is the central photo contained within a smooth, organic mask?

adjustableVariables: Specific color palette within the psychedelic spectrum
Subject matter of the central photograph
mustRedesign: Standard geometric sans-serifs for the main title

mustAchieve: Fluid integration of text and shape

postGenerationChecks: Ensure text is legible despite extreme warping
Check that the photo mask is smooth and organic
Verify that the orange border is continuous around the edge
Confirm no digital artifacts or gradients are present
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine [Art Nouveau organic framing] + [Liquid hand-lettering] + [Central circular photo vignette] + [High-saturation flat color palette].
